title: Lab 1B — Secrets Manager + Cognito config
topic: Secrets Manager vs SSM Parameter Store, GetSecretValue + kms:Decrypt, Cognito wiki auth, Lambda env COGNITO_SECRET_ARN, least-privilege IAM
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces Night 3 saa-study/gsa-wiki-cognito secret lab. Answer without night-3-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×3 B×2 C×2 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Night 3 lab stores GSA wiki Cognito pool ID, client ID, and region in Secrets Manager secret saa-study/gsa-wiki-cognito. Why not paste those values directly into Lambda environment variables?

options.A: Lambda environment variables cannot exceed 128 characters total
options.B: Plaintext env vars appear in the console and logs; Secrets Manager supports rotation and audit
options.C: Cognito rejects tokens when client IDs are supplied via environment variables
options.D: CloudFront requires Secrets Manager for all origin custom headers

questions.question: The wiki-api Lambda role has WikiCognitoSecretRead: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on one secret ARN plus kms:Decrypt on alias/saa-study-witcoskitech. GetSecretValue still fails with AccessDeniedException. What is the first check?

options.A: Whether the secret's KMS key policy allows the Lambda role to use the CMK for decrypt
options.B: Whether API Gateway must assume the Lambda role before each GET request
options.C: Whether Cognito user pool requires MFA for all anonymous wiki reads
options.D: Whether DynamoDB streams must be enabled on WikiPages first

questions.question: When should you pick Secrets Manager over SSM Parameter Store Standard String?

options.A: Always — Parameter Store cannot hold JSON config
options.B: When you need automatic rotation hooks and native secret versioning for credentials
options.C: When the value is public CloudFront cache metadata
options.D: When you need free unlimited API calls with no encryption option

questions.question: SSM Parameter Store SecureString with a KMS CMK is contrasted with Secrets Manager in Night 3. Which statement is accurate?

options.B: Both can encrypt values with KMS; Secrets Manager adds rotation/integration purpose-built for secrets
options.C: Parameter Store replaces Cognito for wiki JWT validation
options.D: SecureString requires a VPC endpoint; Secrets Manager does not

questions.question: sam-app-WikiApiFunction sets COGNITO_SECRET_ARN in environment variables. At runtime the handler calls GetSecretValue. What does the env var hold?

options.A: The Cognito client secret plaintext for JWT validation
options.B: The ARN identifier of the secret — not the password or client secret itself
options.C: The KMS CMK plaintext key material for envelope encryption
options.D: The DynamoDB stream ARN for WikiPages change capture

questions.question: An engineer says KMS already stores the Cognito client secret because the secret is encrypted with a CMK. What is wrong with that statement?

options.A: Nothing — KMS stores all application secrets when SSE-KMS is enabled
options.B: KMS stores and manages encryption keys; Secrets Manager stores the secret value encrypted with those keys
options.C: Cognito stores secrets only in user pool Lambda triggers, not KMS
options.D: CloudTrail stores secrets in log files encrypted with the CMK

questions.question: Anonymous users GET wiki pages; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require a valid Cognito JWT. Where does the Lambda validate the token?

options.A: CloudFront Function at the edge — Lambda never sees auth headers
options.B: wiki-api Lambda using Cognito JWKS after reading pool config from Secrets Manager
options.C: S3 bucket policy Condition on cognito:username for each object key
options.D: DynamoDB fine-grained access control on the partition key only

questions.question: You tighten GetSecretValue from secretsmanager:* on * to one secret ARN. aws iam simulate-principal-policy shows allowed. What does this prove?

options.A: The secret value is now rotated automatically every hour
options.B: The role can fetch that secret under current policies — live calls should succeed if KMS also allows
options.C: CloudWatch Logs will no longer record GetSecretValue API calls
options.D: Cognito will reject tokens from other user pools automatically

questions.question: A bastion EC2 instance in a private subnet is used for admin SSH. Night 3 notes mention replacing it. Which service provides shell access without a bastion or open SSH port?
The secret saa-study/gsa-wiki-cognito is encrypted with CMK alias/saa-study-witcoskitech from Night 2. Deleting the CMK immediately would cause what?

options.A: Only CloudFront cache miss — Secrets Manager keeps plaintext copies in RAM
options.B: GetSecretValue fails — secret ciphertext cannot be decrypted until a valid CMK exists
options.C: Cognito user pool is deleted automatically with the CMK
options.D: Lambda environment variables revert to legacy COGNITO_* names only
